description:
Remove the abandoned synthesized-dispatcher WIP. The β design (epic) needs NO synthesized callback function, so the α prototype is dead and must not coexist with the new path.

REMOVE:
- src/compiler2/jobs/protocol_dispatch.rs (whole module: callback_arms / synthesize_callback_entry_dispatch / dispatcher_row / struct_module_name). NOTE: before deleting, lift the arm-row construction (dispatcher_row + the (impl, receiver_ty) + struct-before-map ordering) into fz-bin.2's matrix builder -- it transplants almost verbatim. So: do fz-bin.2 FIRST harvesting from this file, then delete the file here. (If sequencing is awkward, fz-bin.2 may just copy and this ticket deletes.)
- src/compiler2/jobs/mod.rs: the `mod protocol_dispatch;` registration.
- src/compiler2/jobs/dispatch.rs: the plan_entry_dispatch protocol-callback interception (the `if let Some(callback) = world.protocol_callback(function) { return plan_protocol_callback_entry_dispatch(...) }` branch) and the plan_protocol_callback_entry_dispatch fn. Protocol callbacks no longer get a synthesized EntryDispatch.

VERIFY: lib + matrix green after removal (the WIP was inert -- nothing demanded a callback's EntryDispatch -- so removal is behavior-preserving on its own). Zero warnings.

comments.text: TREE STATE: the α WIP is uncommitted and currently emits one unused-field warning (CallbackArm.impl_function in protocol_dispatch.rs) -- it was the marker for the never-written forwarding body. Harvest (fz-bin.2) + deletion (this ticket) resolve it. Until then the tree fails the -D warnings gate, so fz-bin.2/.4 must land before any commit that runs the clippy gate.
